method: Node fake AudioContext with advancing time, scheduled stop/onended and release watchdog; lifecycle and static template tests. No native browser, decode, playback, mobile measurement or human listening.
releasePolicy: 5 ms gain release, 1 ms stop margin, disconnect after onended; silent/interrupted context watchdog cleanup at 80 ms. whenIdle waits pending, active and releasing voices.
